reviewer: Codex Agent source review (not human), frozen checklist scope, 2026-10-27

criteria.criterion: 真实 Spring 容器关闭时回收裸线程池
criteria.evidence: @Configuration declares @Bean(orderNotifier), retains the created executor in a field, and @PreDestroy shutdown uses shutdown/awaitTermination. The real Spring context test checks lifecycle.

criteria.criterion: 通知任务异常可见且不杀死后续任务处理
criteria.evidence: dispatch executes send inside a worker RuntimeException guard; null orderId triggers observable log evidence, and subsequent tasks are processed. This proves the declared error-isolation criterion, not delivery to a real notification platform.
